snippet.title: Sword & Banner - Trailer
snippet.description:
Sword & Banner is an upcoming RTS game for PC.
You can wishlist Sword & Banner now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4574370/Sword__Banner/?utm_source=youtube

A blend of games like Mount & Blade, Total war, and classic RTS. Trade goods, recruit troops, and conquer lands in a living simulated world.
Featuring multiple playable races, unit upgrade trees, siege assaults and open field battles. The world economy is alive, every caravan you raid, peasant you recruit, and city you raze has real consequence.
